summary.text: Craig Brandt is a Republican who has served in the New Mexico Senate since 2013, representing District 40 in Sandoval County.
Brandt is ranking member of the Senate Finance Committee.

paragraphs.text: The legislature's member page lists Brandt's occupation as clergy and a district office in Rio Rancho.

Between sessions, Brandt is a member of the Legislative Education Study Committee, the New Mexico Finance Authority Oversight Committee and the Revenue Stabilization and Tax Policy Committee, and serves in an advisory role on the Legislative Finance Committee and the Legislative Council.
